approach: Count requests per API key in a store every instance shares, and enforce the count in one middleware the public routes both pass through, so the limit holds across the load balancer rather than per instance.

steps.description: Add a shared counter store keyed by API key and time window, so every instance reads and increments the same count instead of counting on its own.
Add a rate-limit middleware that runs after authentication and applies to both public endpoints in the route registration.
Reject a request over the limit with a 429 response carrying a Retry-After header, leaving the handler untouched.
Read the per-plan limit from configuration so each API key plan can carry its own allowance without a code change.

risks: A store outage must fail open or closed deliberately; leaving it unspecified turns every request into an error.
